text: DSH 插件模板（DSH 插件，通用客户端）：提供一个可复制后开发的独立 Cordis 函数插件起点。入口导出插件名称、空依赖列表、配置 schema 和 apply 函数；配置一条默认或自定义消息，激活时通过 DSH 宿主日志记录。还包含插件 bundle 配置和 Loader 行为测试，适合需要从基础结构开始编写 DSH 插件的开发者。无需额外密钥或外部服务。

DSH Plugin Template is a DSH Cordis plugin scaffold for developers. It exports a name, empty dependency list, configuration schema, and apply function. Activation logs a configurable message through the host. Bundle metadata and Loader tests are included. No API key or external service is required.

DSH 插件模板的功能「配置激活消息」：插件配置可提供 message 字符串，默认值为“DSH plugin template loaded”。插件激活时将解析后的消息写入宿主 logger。
DSH 插件模板的功能「函数插件入口骨架」：入口导出稳定名称、空的服务依赖列表、Config schema 和 apply 函数，供 Cordis Loader 载入并由宿主上下文激活。

@your-scope/dsh-plugin-template README · DeepSeek Harness Plugin Template：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A self-contained standalone repository template for an ESM Cordis plugin targeting DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1. Every source file, compiler setting, test fixture, contributor instruction, skill, and build helper used by the repository lives below this root. A DSH host is a runtime consumer of the finished package, not a development input.

@your-scope/dsh-plugin-template README · Package contract：[docs/dsh-plugin-contracts.md](docs/dsh-plugin-contracts.md) owns the full contract. The orientation points are:

@your-scope/dsh-plugin-template README · Package contract：- A function plugin exports `name`, `inject`, `Config`, and `apply` as one ESM namespace and has no default export.
- `engines.node` is `>=24.9.0`; `engines.dsh` declares the supported DSH range; `dsh.manifestVersion` and `dsh.bundle.patch` describe the public bundle layer.
- Display metadata reaches Plugin Manager through the exported `./locale/*.json` and `./icon` resources. This template stores their physical files under `src/assets/` and lists them in `files`.
- `@deepseek-ai/cordis` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` are host-supplied peers, duplicated in `devDependencies` for local checks. See [dependencies](docs/dsh-plugin-contracts.md#dependencies).
- A browser face declares `dsh.client` and exports its built bundle at `./client`.

@your-scope/dsh-plugin-template README · Create your plugin：1. Replace package identity in `package.json`, the Loader owner, configuration/runtime owners, focused tests, bundle metadata, TypeScript metadata, both READMEs, `AGENTS.md`, and `src/assets/`.
2. Choose the exact npm package name. It may be scoped or unscoped; do not assume the template's `@your-scope/dsh-` prefix. Replace it only in identity owners, never globally inside `.agents/skills/`.
3. Set `engines.dsh` to the range you support. Keep `engines.node` at Node 24 LTS or newer unless a different host contract is deliberate.
4. Update `keywords`, `LICENSE`, `cordis.patch.yml`, and the display title, description, and icon.
5. Add only the DSH host services the implementation uses. Apply [dependencies](docs/dsh-plugin-contracts.md#dependencies) when placing each package.
6. Implement activation and host-boundary behavior in the runtime/service owners, keeping registrations fiber-owned and disposing them in tests.
7. Keep every source, compiler, documentation, and project-reference path inside this repository. Do not add `link:` or `file:` dependencies.
8. Set `private` to `false` only when the package's public dependencie

@your-scope/dsh-plugin-template README · Create your plugin：Do not add a default export to a function plugin. Cordis Loader unwraps `exports.default ?? exports`; a stray default export discards `inject`, `Config`, and `apply`.

@your-scope/dsh-plugin-template README · Bundled development skills：Keep these directories when copying the template.

@your-scope/dsh-plugin-template README · Independent development：Run from this repository root:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run lint
pnpm test
pnpm run build

`lint` is the type-aware static-analysis gate. `test` uses the Vitest `forks` pool; a restricted host that rejects child-process forks can run `vitest run --pool=threads` locally. `build` emits the ready-to-pack `lib/` runtime and declarations without an install-time build.

@your-scope/dsh-plugin-template README · CI：- [ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml): frozen install, lint, tests, and build on pushes to `main` and pull requests.
- [release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml): the same checks, then packs the tarball and publishes it to the version's GitHub Release.

@your-scope/dsh-plugin-template README · Profile activation：Install through the plugin channel:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <package-or-tarball>
```

Profile startup checks `engines.dsh`, applies `dsh.bundle.patch` in bundle order, and reads display metadata without activating the plugin. See [manifest and compatibility](docs/dsh-plugin-contracts.md#manifest-and-compatibility) and [bundle composition](docs/dsh-plugin-contracts.md#bundle-composition).

@your-scope/dsh-plugin-template README · Plugin forms：```ts
export const name = 'plugin-template'
export const inject: string[] = []
export { Config } from './config.ts'
export { apply } from './runtime.ts'

`Config` is the schema value Cordis Loader validates; `PluginConfig` is the public TypeScript shape. Keeping the names distinct avoids the declaration-merge false positive in `no-redeclare`. A service provider instead default-exports its `Service` subclass; do not mix the two forms.

@your-scope/dsh-plugin-template README · Distribution：Build before packing and inspect the archive:

```sh
pnpm run build
pnpm pack --dry-run --json
```

The archive must contain every file promised by `main`, `types`, `exports`, and `files`, plus the bundle patch and the physical display assets. See [build and distribution](docs/dsh-plugin-contracts.md#build-and-distribution). Git installs fetch sources; only add a self-contained `prepare` build when you deliberately distribute that way and document the consumer's build-script approval.

@your-scope/dsh-plugin-template README · Testing：The baseline tests prove Loader-safe ESM exports and schema-resolved activation. Replace the activation assertions with observable behavior and disposal assertions for every registry contribution. Product-visible plugins also need a real Loader/profile composition test in the consuming DSH application; see [tests/LAYOUT.md](tests/LAYOUT.md) and [evidence](docs/dsh-plugin-contracts.md#evidence).
